让房间空气经过换热器: Pass room air through a heat exchanger
贯流风扇把房间的空气从顶部吸入，让它经过滤网与翅片，再从下方送回房间。空气留在房: The cross-flow fan draws room air through the filter and fins and returns it through the lower outlet. The air stays indoors. Refrigerant travels through the two copper pipes in the wall.
空气与制冷剂不混合；风扇用电也会变成热。: Air and refrigerant never mix. Fan electricity also becomes heat.
把热交给室外，或从室外取热: Reject heat outside, or collect it
制冷时，室外机要排出从房间取走的热，还要排出压缩机做功带来的热。切到冬季制热，同: In cooling mode, the outdoor unit rejects both the heat collected indoors and the compressor work. In winter, the same coil becomes the evaporator: colder refrigerant collects heat from outdoor air.
换热器的角色可以互换，压缩机的方向不反转。: The coils exchange roles. The compressor does not reverse its rotation.
做功，建立高低压两侧: Do work and maintain two pressure levels
一片涡旋固定，另一片沿很小的圆轨道平移，自身不旋转。月牙形气腔把气体逐步带向中央: One scroll is fixed. The other translates around a small circular orbit without rotating. Crescent-shaped pockets carry gas inward and shrink, raising its pressure. Suction and discharge states come from the same R32 property model.
机构示意以 1/100 慢放；气腔色点示意压缩过程，不是流体仿真。: Mechanism shown at 1/100 speed. Pocket tracers illustrate compression; they are not a fluid simulation.
低压沸腾，把热吸进来: Boil at low pressure and absorb heat
低压液气混合物吸热，液体逐渐变成蒸气。两相区中，焓持续增加，温度却基本保持在该压: A low-pressure mixture absorbs heat as liquid becomes vapor. Through the two-phase region, enthalpy rises while temperature stays at the saturation temperature for that pressure. After the last liquid evaporates, the vapor gains 5 K of superheat.
拖动沿程探针：干度是蒸气的质量分数，不是气泡体积分数。: Move the probe: quality is the vapor mass fraction, not the volume occupied by bubbles.
高压凝结，把热送出去: Condense at high pressure and release heat
压缩机排出的过热蒸气先降温，再在高压下凝结，最后过冷 3 K。制冷时它在室外，制: Hot discharge vapor first cools, then condenses at high pressure, then gains 3 K of subcooling. This coil is outdoors in cooling mode and indoors in heating mode. Heat release follows the enthalpy drop of the same refrigerant flow.
冷凝放出的热 = 蒸发吸收的热 + 压缩做功。: Condenser heat = evaporator heat + compressor work.
节流降压，产生低温两相混合物: Throttle to a colder two-phase mixture
狭窄通道让压力下降。节流近似没有轴功、没有对外换热，进出口焓相同。一部分液体闪蒸: The restriction lowers pressure. With negligible shaft work and external heat exchange, throttling preserves enthalpy. Some liquid flashes into vapor; the remaining liquid cools to the low-pressure saturation temperature.
等焓不等于等温，也不是产生能量。: Constant enthalpy does not mean constant temperature or energy creation.
让两组换热器交换角色: Exchange the roles of the two coils
换向阀重新连接压缩机的高压出口、低压入口与两组换热器。制热并不是让电热丝发热：它: The reversing valve reconnects compressor discharge and suction to the two coils. Heating primarily moves heat rather than generating it in a resistance wire. The winter preset loads fresh indoor and outdoor conditions for comparison.
这里计算干空气显热；未模拟结霜、化霜与除湿。: Dry-air sensible heat model. Frost, defrost and dehumidification are not simulated.
用更大的面积与更多空气换热: Exchange heat across more area and airflow
密集的铝翅片把铜管的换热面积展开。风量提高能改善换热，但风扇功率按风量的三次方增: Dense aluminum fins extend the copper tubes’ exchange area. More airflow improves heat transfer, but fan power rises with the cube of airflow here. Air heat-capacity rate and exchanger effectiveness determine the supply temperature.
风量更大不一定更省电，试着比较系统 COP。: Higher airflow does not always save electricity. Compare the system COP.
空调搬走了什么？: What does the air conditioner move?
屋里的空气没有跑到室外。热穿过铜管里的制冷剂，交给另一侧的空气。先让房间运行几分: Room air does not travel outside. Heat passes through the refrigerant to the air on the other side. Run a few minutes, then try opening the window.
取下外壳，看见风扇、翅片、铜管与密封压缩机。所有这些结构都服务于一条闭合的冷媒回: Remove the casings to find fans, fins, copper tubes and the sealed compressor. Every assembly serves one closed refrigerant loop.
近看两片涡旋：铜色部件只沿小圆轨道平移。气体从外缘进入，逐步被挤到中央。: Watch the scroll pair: the copper-colored scroll only translates along a small orbit. Gas enters at the rim and is compressed toward the center.
吸热了，温度为什么不变？: Why can heat rise without temperature?
把探针沿蒸发器移动。两相区吸收的热用来汽化液体，温度维持在低压对应的沸点。: Move the probe through the evaporator. In the two-phase region, heat vaporizes liquid while temperature stays at the boiling point for that pressure.
换向后，室外换热器变成蒸发器。把室外温度调低，观察取热能力、能效与房间温度一起变: After reversal, the outdoor coil becomes the evaporator. Lower the outdoor temperature and watch heating capacity, efficiency and room temperature change together.
一间房 · 两台机器 · 一股循环的制冷剂: One room · two units · one refrigerant loop
切换季节会重载初始房温、室外温度与电量。: Season presets reset room conditions, outdoor temperature and energy.
冬季按无霜干空气计算；真实结霜和化霜会降低性能。: Winter assumes frost-free dry air. Real frost and defrost reduce performance.
试试开窗、遮阳或改变风量。房间空气先响应，墙体和家具慢慢跟随。: Try the window, shade or airflow. Air responds first; walls and furniture follow slowly.
